links.note: The dividing lines being conventions rather than natural boundaries, since seawater constantly flows across them - this concept's qualification of its own list of five. Already linked and correct.
Marine flora as tiny plants called algae and all kinds of seaweeds - this concept's description. Already linked and correct.
Cyclones as violent storms with extreme rainfall or very strong winds that can damage coastal regions - this concept's description. Already linked and correct.

Early warning systems - this concept explains that tsunamis can often be detected before they hit a coast, which is why many countries collaborate on them, including the Indian Ocean Tsunami Warning System.
Why the count varies between four and seven - this concept's case-by-case reasoning about the Americas and about Europe and Asia. Already linked and correct.
The Indian Antarctica Programme, running since 1981, with about 40 teams researching the evolution of climate and environment - this concept's account. Already linked and correct.
Oceans regulating the climate and sustaining life, producing more than half the world's oxygen - this concept's claim. Already linked and correct.
People using oceans and seas from early times to migrate, to trade, for military campaigns and for fishing - this concept's list. Already linked and correct.

World Oceans Day reminding us of the ocean's role as the planet's lungs, a source of food and medicine and a critical part of the biosphere - this concept's closing sentence. Already linked and correct.
Several million tonnes of plastic waste thrown into the oceans every year, choking marine life - this concept's statement. Already linked and correct.
Overfishing glossed as excessive fishing and named as a cause of the decline of marine life - this concept's sentence. Already linked and correct.
The Andaman and Nicobar Islands in the Bay of Bengal and the Lakshadweep Islands in the Arabian Sea - this concept names both groups with their waters.

Disaster management - this concept is where events leading to loss of life and property are said to be handled under disaster management, for which India has its National Disaster Management Authority.
Groundwater as the underground part of the planet's freshwater - this concept names it alongside glaciers, rivers, lakes and the atmosphere.
The ways oceans have impacted humanity - migration, trade, military campaigns, fishing, and the tales and legends of coastal cultures - this concept's list. Already linked and correct.
The Indian Ocean for India, with the Arabian Sea to the west and the Bay of Bengal to the east - this concept's box on its limits and its two parts. Already linked and correct.

Why countries must cooperate - this concept states that tsunamis can often be detected before they hit a coast, which is why many countries collaborate in early warning systems including the Indian Ocean Tsunami Warning System.

The Indian Antarctica Programme and its research on the evolution of climate and environment - this concept's account, down to the base stations and the settlement where the scientists live. Already linked and correct.
Oceans and continents not distributed equally between the hemispheres - this concept's opening, and its LET'S EXPLORE asks which hemisphere holds more water. Already linked and correct.
Oceans sending rain to the continents as part of the Earth's water cycle, without which the Earth would be a desert - this concept's statement. Already linked and correct.

Greenland as the largest island, and islands in general as land surrounded by water on all sides - this concept's material, which is the ground of the comparison. Already linked and defensible, so left alone.

Europe and Asia treated as two continents for historical and cultural reasons although the map shows a single landmass - this concept's own explanation, and its point that the answer depends on which criterion is applied.

Which hemisphere holds more land or water, and whether oceans and continents are equally distributed - this concept opens on the unequal distribution and its LET'S EXPLORE asks exactly these questions of the two hemisphere maps. Already linked and correct.

A fishing community facing declining catch and plastic debris - this concept names both threats, plastic waste choking marine life and overfishing causing the decline of marine life, and closes on collective responsibility. Already linked and correct.

Whether a sea like the Arabian Sea is part of a larger ocean - this concept states that the Arabian Sea and the Bay of Bengal are two parts of the Indian Ocean on either side of India. Already linked and correct.
